title: Person
description: One person across all apps: contact, notification target and - when enabled - login. Field names follow the portal implementation (moved from Process Data's alert_users).

id.description: Stable person id (UUID); person groups and modules reference it (IAM-06).

name.description: Display name - the only stored name.

email.description: Company e-mail; directory-owned after Entra binding, used for notifications and as second first-login match (people bound to another account are ignored).

upn.description: Entra ID user principal name. Directory-owned after binding; before it an administrator may enter it to name the account to connect. Matched first on a Microsoft or card sign-in (IAM-07).

identities.description: External identities, bound exactly once; preserve other providers.

notificationChannel.description: Personal delivery preference: 'mail' or 'teams'. Portal new-person default is mail; missing/invalid values are delivery configuration failures, not a fallback to another channel.

active.description: Contact activity, independent of login_enabled; inactive contacts are excluded from notifications. Disabling a person disables login too; reactivation does not restore login. Never delete (references stay valid).

login_enabled.description: Login allowed; a login needs active and login_enabled. Active contacts can receive notifications without login; removing/disabling login preserves contact activity and group membership. The portal sets it at the first Microsoft or card sign-in of a person that is not blocked.

login_blocked.description: Explicit sign-in block set by an administrator (Sign-in allowed unticked, Remove login) or for a directory leaver. Only this, or an inactive person, refuses a Microsoft or card sign-in; a login that was never enabled does not. Portal only.

last_login_at.description: Last successful personal sign-in (any method). Portal only.

password_hash.description: scrypt hash; never returned by any API.

must_change_password.description: Force a password change at the next login.

session_version.description: Incremented to revoke all sessions of the person.

role_ids.description: Protected platform capability markers (ROLE-systemadministrator, ROLE-admin) only; app grants live in person_app_access@1. Module role IDs were removed with portal 1.19.

preferred_plant_id.description: Last plant chosen in the plant switcher.

language.description: UI language chosen by the person (LNG-05); default en.

entra_identity_key.description: Unique tenant UUID + colon + object UUID; partial unique string index. Portal only.

rfid_card_id.description: Card number: Graph onPremisesExtensionAttributes.extensionAttribute9 for bound persons (formatting/leading zeros preserved), else entered by an administrator. Authenticates only on registered card terminals (IAM-17); never a grant or generic identity payload field.

rfid_card_source.description: Where rfid_card_id comes from. directory: extensionAttribute9, read-only in People. manual: entered by an administrator for a person without a directory card (e.g. externals); a directory card replaces it, an empty attribute keeps it. Missing: directory for bound persons, else manual. Portal only.

rfid_card_key.description: Comparable card number (letters/digits, upper case) for terminal lookup; portal only, never in identity payloads.

cost_center.description: Graph extensionAttribute1: SAP cost center. Directory-owned; data only.

department_id.description: Graph extensionAttribute3: SAP department (org unit) ID. Directory-owned; data only.

job_title_id.description: Graph extensionAttribute7: SAP job (position) ID. Directory-owned; data only.

employee_id.description: Graph employeeId: group-wide personnel number. Directory-owned; data only.

personnel_number.description: Current local personnel number (not the group-wide employee_id), typed on card terminals (decision 0034). Unique among persons that have one. Portal-owned until the directory provides it; never an authorization input.

directory_account_enabled.description: Graph accountEnabled at the last sync. false disables login (IAM-18).

directory_licensed.description: A licence is assigned in Entra: the practical hint that the person uses Microsoft sign-in. Never an authorization input.

provisioned_by.description: How the portal created this person: from the directory by login, card or admin, or personnel_number (typed on a card terminal, not verified; decision 0034).

screen_navigation.description: Full navigation on screens: with a card sign-in on a registered screen the person may leave the board (sidebar, other apps). Missing means true; the portal sets false for people created by a card. Microsoft and password sessions are never locked. Navigation only, never a grant.

merged_into.description: Person id this automatically created duplicate was merged into; the entry is inactive.
